title: Which club will sign Jaouen Hadjam from Young Boys during the 2026 summer transfer window?
background: Jaouen Hadjam is an Algerian international left-back who joined Young Boys in 2024.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : An official announcement from Young Boys or the acquiring club confirming Hadjam's permanent transfer during the 2026 summer transfer window. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the destination club named in the first official announcement confirming the transfer. Resolution occurs on the announcement date, rather than the player's debut. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The destination club's name.
